item.title: Wed 28 Oct: Banks lend $63B for Anthropic chips
item.description: Broadcom has reportedly closed a $63B vehicle to finance Anthropic's chips, with Citi among the lenders, and Anthropic's S-1 shows the scale of its compute bills. Also in the brief: Meta's raise nears $100B, and Cloudflare and LiteLLM leaks show AI infrastructure risk.

item.title: Mon 26 Oct: Wall Street asks where AI pays
item.description: Apollo's chief economist says AI has delivered zero payoff outside Big Tech, as Meta's credit spread hits a record. Also: Washington turns on AI's chief executives, and China's AI compute is set to double in 2027.
